mechanism_narrative: The steady four-week rise in RETAIL_REC from -13.7 to -10.9 reflects building reopening momentum; this trend continues, lifting the next 28-day mean above the last 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose from -13.7 at t-3w to -10.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days has a mean less than or equal to the last 28-day mean despite the observed four-week upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM rises above 35, households are stockpiling essentials and avoiding discretionary retail; this substitution depresses RETAIL_REC over the next week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean >= 35 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rose from 31.6 at t-3w to 37.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: When GROCERY_PHARM is at or above 35 for two consecutive weeks, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not lower than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Recovering transit and workplace mobility interact to restore commuting and lunchtime footfall; when TRANSIT rises above -6 and WORKPLACES above -5, RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -9.4 at t-2w to -5.3 at t-0w; WORKPLACES improved from -9.3 at t-2w to -3.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: When TRANSIT > -6 and WORKPLACES > -5, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Under tightening restrictions, parks mobility remains depressed and volatile below -10; this signals outdoor leisure substitution away from retail, keeping RETAIL_REC below baseline over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was -17.0 at t-1w and -14.6 at t-0w, both below -10
failure_condition: In weeks where PARKS < -10, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than or equal to the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: High grocery/pharmacy stockpiling combined with elevated residential stay-home behavior jointly suppress retail-recreation trips; when both are elevated, RETAIL_REC falls over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM was 37.6 and RESIDENTIAL 6.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: When GROCERY_PHARM > 35 and RESIDENTIAL > 6, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not lower than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal late-spring easing typically lifts discretionary mobility; with TRANSIT and WORKPLACES already improving, this seasonal tailwind raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improved from t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the last 28-day mean despite TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improving in late spring.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC crossing above -12 for the first time in four weeks signals a momentum breakout in discretionary activity; this breakout persists, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC was -12.1 at t-1w and -10.9 at t-0w, crossing above -12
failure_condition: After RETAIL_REC crosses above -12, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: In a heightened alert regime, transit and workplace mobility remain negative and interact to suppress retail footfall; with TRANSIT < -5 and WORKPLACES < 0, RETAIL_REC declines over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT -5.3 and WORKPLACES -3.7 at t-0w remain below zero
